messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v2026.3.15 -> canary (10%) -> stable. Rollout policy: gradual-quick. CI: https://ci.redwood/integrations/7890

alice: oncall here — noticed a spike in 5xx from canary group at 12:06 UTC, route=/generate, canary hosts = runtime-canary-*. 5xx rate ~12% (baseline ~0.5%).

ben: forwarding dashboards: https://metrics.redwood/d/runtime-errors?org=redwood — panels show tail latency and per-host 5xx heatmap.

carmen: did auto-rollback trigger? last policy set to auto-fallback on 5xx>2% over 1m.

deploy-bot: automated rollback did NOT trigger — healthcheck endpoint returned intermittent 200s which prevented the threshold from being met.

alice: ok we need manual mitigation. Plan: 1) siphon traffic off canary, 2) flip feature flag 'enable-new-routing' off, 3) validate with smoke tests, 4) notify CS. Anyone on deck to execute?

ben: executing traffic siphon now — running: kubectl scale deployment runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n prod && svc-routerctl set-weight runtime-canary 0 --env=prod

ben: flipping flag: curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/flip -d '{"flag":"enable-new-routing","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **redacted**'

carmen: flag flip acknowledged by flags-service :white_check_mark: — propagation to edge ~20s.

elaine: monitoring: 5xx dropping from 12% -> 1.2% within 40s. CPU on canary hosts draining. Latency stable. Preparing brief for CS.

cust-success-bot: creating customer update draft. Impact: limited to canary traffic (~10% of traffic) for a brief window. Suggested severity: P2 (partial degradation). Notifying account teams for top 3 customers.

alice: quick verification — running a smoke call against /generate with sample prompt:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **redacted**' -sS | jq .status
# expected: 200
```
Response: 200, output tokens look sane.

sean: running regional sanity: ./ops/check-routes.sh --env=prod --regions=all -> all regions report canary weight 0%.

ben: double-checking rollout owner and canceling any pending canary increments in deploy control plane. Cancel op id: deploy-7890-cancelled.

elaine: metrics fully back to baseline after 2m; no customer escalations opened so far. Kicking off an incident note and assigning postmortem work.

alice: root cause hypothesis: healthcheck false positives suppressed auto-rollback. Action items: (A) tighten healthcheck logic to surface 5xx ratio, (B) add a short-circuit circuit-breaker that triggers on 5xx>2% for 2m, (C) add a synthetic canary smoke that verifies generation outputs instead of plain healthcheck.

cory: (paged) ack'd, will own postmortem and follow-up. Creating ticket INC-4678 and assigning fixes to infra/serving.

alice: summary: traffic drained from canary, feature flag flipped off, smoke tests pass, metrics stable. Handoff to release-owner for postmortem. Closing thread. :lock:
